OPERATIONS
==========


POWER ON/OFF
------------

.. raw:: html

   <img class="hb-source-operation" src="renderers/web/assets/je1000e_sil_us_en/power_art.png" alt="Power On/Off" data-operation="{&quot;id&quot;: &quot;main-power&quot;, &quot;layout&quot;: &quot;status-right&quot;, &quot;step_ids&quot;: [&quot;on&quot;, &quot;off&quot;], &quot;steps_rect&quot;: [76, 17, 22, 33], &quot;capture_prerequisite&quot;: false, &quot;capture_following_lines&quot;: 2, &quot;presentation_mode&quot;: &quot;base-art-live-copy&quot;, &quot;base_art_layout&quot;: {&quot;art_sha256&quot;: &quot;cc4a6c69ae614c0c80317f85d0f6b7e0e41efe8fd383bc4f8ff1eb18a093239f&quot;, &quot;step_anchors&quot;: [[76.5, 21], [76.5, 34]], &quot;step_width&quot;: 22.5, &quot;duration_anchor&quot;: [82, 43], &quot;supporting_anchor&quot;: [43, 57, 52]}}" />
   <div class="line-block">
   <div class="line"><strong>On</strong></div>
   <div class="line">Press once</div>
   <div class="line"><strong>Off</strong></div>
   <div class="line">Press and hold for 3s</div>
   <div class="line"><strong>Default standby time:</strong> 12 hours<br />If the Main power button is turned off and there is no charging input or output, the product will automatically shut down after 12 hours.</div>
   <div class="line">* The standby time can be set in the Jackery App. Disable this mode when powering low-power loads (&lt;20W), as it may automatically shut down the output.</div>
   </div>
